items.stem: A team runs the same CSV-to-Excel summary every month with identical formatting rules. Why is packaging it as a Skill preferable to re-prompting each time?

options.text: The Skill captures the instructions, scripts and formatting once so the task runs consistently and repeatably
options.rationale: Correct: a Skill encodes the repeatable procedure, reducing drift between runs.

options.text: A Skill makes Claude respond faster on every unrelated request
options.rationale: A Skill does not speed up unrelated requests; it standardises a specific task.

options.text: A Skill removes the need to ever verify the output
options.rationale: Output must still be verified; a Skill standardises the steps, not correctness.

options.text: A Skill lets Claude edit the source CSV in place without permission
options.rationale: A Skill does not grant unrequested write access to source files.

items.explanation: Correct: a Skill encodes the repeatable procedure, reducing drift between runs.

items.stem: Which TWO checks should a document Skill perform before its output is trusted for a board pack? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Reconcile every total in the output against the source export
options.rationale: Correct: totals must trace back to the source to catch transformation errors.

options.text: Confirm the output file opens without a format error
options.rationale: Correct: a corrupt or unreadable file is an immediate failure to catch early.

options.text: Check that the output file is larger than the source
options.rationale: File size is not a meaningful correctness signal.

options.text: Ask Claude whether it is confident in the numbers
options.rationale: A model's stated confidence is not independent verification.

items.explanation: Correct: totals must trace back to the source to catch transformation errors.

items.stem: A source workbook contains client-identifying data. Before a Skill processes it, what is the right first step?

options.text: Classify the document's sensitivity and confirm retention and sharing settings allow this use
options.rationale: Correct: sensitivity classification and settings come before processing confidential data.

options.text: Run the Skill immediately to save time
options.rationale: Processing confidential data before checking settings is the risk being avoided.

options.text: Rename the file so the data looks anonymised
options.rationale: Renaming does not remove identifying content from the data.

options.text: Share the file publicly so the team can all run the Skill
options.rationale: Public sharing increases exposure of confidential data.

items.explanation: Correct: sensitivity classification and settings come before processing confidential data.
